claim_boundary: Read-only development attribution on failed sealed checkpoints. It cannot promote V23/V24, certify Phase 3, or establish ABI superiority.

decision.rule: V26 cannot authorize training. If both sealed systems fail training fit, assign the next design problem to ABI model capacity, optimization, or target representation before considering data expansion. If teacher-forced training fit passes but autonomous training responses fail, require a materially distinct causal state-recovery architecture. Only if training fit and autonomous training replay pass while held-out accuracy falls may acquisition diversity or generalization become the primary owner. Report unrepresentable development targets independently. Any successor requires a new preregistration and must target the measured owner; the LayerCake v2 host remains unchanged.
